separate_rounding_diagnosis.method: Cast independently computed float64 W1 numerator to float32, divide by native float32 denominator, compare exactly. This reproduces source NumPy scalar promotion; it does not replace the frozen float64 recalculation criterion.

contract.method: For equal-size DDPM/solver amplitude ensembles, exact empirical W1 = mean(abs(sorted(generated_amplitudes)-sorted(solver_amplitudes))), computed in float64 from each native float32 array std. Normalize by native solver-amplitude mean as declared source. This independent rank-pair formula differs from source CDF-area implementation.
contract.if_failure: Preserve failure and diagnose; no tolerance change.
contract.baseline_scope: Baseline arrays are not retained by frozen secondary; check their reported counts/finite values and summary recomputation only, not independent baseline sample values.

data.scope: Frozen collection and independent DDPM metric checks. Failure retained; no raw output replaced. Baseline/marginal fields were not returned, so their sample metrics were not independently recalculated.
